args.task_description: 实现 add-a-full-pane 功能：Add a full-pane Runtime -> Email entry inside existing non-DEV Coding Tools, connected to the user's existing Cloudflare Workers email setup. User is signed into Cloudflare and confirms using Workers. Display a message list and safe readable email content. Inspect existing Worker API and storage before selecting an adapter; deployment, DNS/routing changes, sending, automatic replies, deletion, and AI reading of messages are not yet requested or approved. Reuse current app integration, local credential handling, and GUI patterns. This is architectural discovery and design first; no product implementation before design/spec/plan approval. Preserve current MCP, AO, CPA, proxy, native Codex, and active workspace changes. Need Worker identity/API and mailbox scope from existing signed-in session or user.

globalRules: 首次执行计划时调用 plan_heartbeat 并附完整 plan，建立本地检查点
每完成、跳过或阻塞一个步骤后调用 plan_heartbeat 更新证据与状态
会话中断或切换 Agent 后先调用 resume_plan，再继续未完成步骤
只有 converge 返回 passed=true 后，才能将本次结论正式写入长期记忆
Agent 必须按步骤顺序调用 MCP，并使用宿主能力完成真实文件与代码操作
首次执行前必须用完整 plan 建立 plan_heartbeat 检查点；每完成、跳过或阻断一步立即累计回写
check_spec 未通过前不得进入实现阶段
不得把 delegated plan 的输出误认为代码已经实施
历史记忆仅作为参考，当前项目事实与代码优先
